name: Band Under-Feet Squat
setup: Stand on the middle of a long band, feet shoulder-width. Loop it over both shoulders, or hold the ends at your shoulders.
cues: Sit down between your heels, then stand the band up tall.
Spread the floor with your feet on the way up.
Keep the band path straight up and down.

faults.fault: Knees falling in as the band pulls down
faults.fix: Push the floor apart with your feet on the way up.
Keep the whole foot pressed down on the band.

name: Band Front Squat
setup: Stand on the middle of a long band, feet shoulder-width. Hold the ends at the front of your shoulders, elbows high and pointing forward.
cues: Hold the band ends high in front, like carrying a tray.
Sit straight down between your heels.
Stand the band up tall and quiet.

faults.fault: Elbows dropping and the chest folding forward
faults.fix: Keep the band ends high and pointed at the wall in front.

faults.fault: Knees falling in on the way up
faults.fix: Spread the floor with your feet.

name: Band Split Squat
setup: Split stance, front foot standing on the middle of a long band. Hold the ends at your shoulders.
cues: Drop the back knee straight down toward the floor.
Push the floor away with the front foot to stand up.
Keep the band path straight up and down.

faults.fix: Keep the front knee over the middle toes.

faults.fault: Leaning forward over the front leg
faults.fix: Stay tall, like a wall is in front of your chest.

cautions: Pick the band split squat with both feet on the floor until the balance feels steady.
name: Band Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
setup: Back foot on a sturdy chair or step. Front foot on the middle of a long band; ends held at your shoulders.
cues: Drop straight down between the front foot and the chair.
Push the floor away with the front foot.
Keep the band path straight up and down.

faults.fix: Drive the floor away in front; the chair only holds balance.
Keep the front knee over the middle toes.

cautions: Pick the incline push-up if the head-down position feels like too much.
name: Pike Push-Up
setup: Hands on the floor shoulder-width, hips high so your body makes an upside-down V, feet walked in close.
cues: Lower the top of your head toward a spot in front of your hands.
Push the floor away until the arms are long.
Keep the upside-down V tall the whole set.

faults.fault: Hips dropping into a regular push-up
faults.fix: Walk in closer until the V is tall again.
Lower toward the floor in an arrow shape, not a T.

name: Step-In Mountain Climber
setup: High plank, hands under shoulders, body long from head to heels.
cues: Step in toward the floor under your chest, then back out, and switch.
Stay flat enough to balance a tray.
Quick, quiet steps: the feet never leave the floor together.

faults.fault: Hips piking up as the pace rises
faults.fix: Stay long and flat as a plank of wood.
One foot at a time, always one foot on the floor.
